Data Inventory - no actual data of our own but we serve a lot of data from other Divisions and produce products and web pages

## Data Services and Models

* Satellite data/CoastWatch
  - Developed specifically for climate and ecosystem work
* Species Distribution Models
  - EcoCast
  - WhaleWatch
  - TurtleWatch (TOTAL)
  - Top Predator
  - More/future
* CCIEA
  - Indicator dashboard
  - Whale Entanglement dashboard
  - ESR data uploader
    + Multiple PI data uploads
    +Ports data to ERDDAP
  - ESR technical documentation
  - Images for IEA/CCIEA project pages
* SWFSC/ESD
  - CalCOFI Farallon Institute Seabirds
  - CalCOFI NOAA (lots of stuff!)
  - CalCOFI SIO Hydrographic Bottle Data, Cast Data
* SWFSC Other Division Products/ Data on inPort
  - FED
    + Rockfish Cruise data - ERDDAP
    + JSATS California Fish Tracking
    + Thiamine Deficiency in California Salmon 
    + Sacramento River Valley Salmonid Tagging Project
    + California Current Trophic Database (Food Habits, Predator/Prey Taxonomy)
    + California South Delta Acoustic Telemetry
* FRD
    + California Current Pelagic Fish Surveys, 1950-1989 (Bathythermograph, Night Scout Data, Visual Scout Data, Anchovy Schools, Age Data, Length Frequencies, Species Composition)
    + Billfish Tagging Program
    + CPS Trawl Life History (Haul Catch Data, Specimen Data, Length Frequency Data, Nearshore Set Catch Data, Nearshore Specimen Data)
    + International Billfish Angler Survey
    + CCS Species Distribution Models for coastal pelagic species 
    + CCS Projections for northern anchovy 
    + Sardine Potential Habitat
    + Swordfish, Albacore tuna, Bluefin diet
    + Highly Migratory Species (Biomass, REcruitment)
* Models: operational running & services/output
    + Marine Heat Wave (ESD)
    + CVTEMP (FED)
    + Species Distribution Models (ESD)
* Web pages/services
